title: Latency and timeouts on storage-svc

detection.alert: storage-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on storage-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] storage-svc 2026-08-29 07:12-08:09: storage-svc: 8 of 10 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-29 07:12 and 2026-08-29 08:09 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} shrinks its outbound timeout by a factor of 1000, so calls time out almost immediately.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) converts http.timeout_ms with the wrong unit.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; fix the unit conversion at {file}:{line}; add a unit test for the timeout conversion.

rca.macro: Deploy v4.27.0 of storage-svc shrinks its outbound timeout by a factor of 1000, so calls time out almost immediately.
rca.micro: storage/datanode/DataXceiver.java:289 (DataXceiver.readBlock) converts http.timeout_ms with the wrong unit.
rca.remediation: Roll back storage-svc v4.27.0 -> v4.26.0; fix the unit conversion at storage/datanode/DataXceiver.java:289; add a unit test for the timeout conversion.

action_items: Add a regression test covering DataXceiver.readBlock (storage/datanode/DataXceiver.java).
Alert on the error signature `<*> exception while serving <*> to <*>`.
